jobs_results.title: Test engineer for validation and certification motorcycles testing
jobs_results.description:
Applus IDIADA es unsocio global de la industria de la automocióncon más de 30 años de experiencia apoyando a sus clientes en las actividades de desarrollo de productos mediante la prestación de servicios dediseño, ingeniería, ensayos y homologación.

El éxito de IDIADA en el desarrollo de productos se basa en una combinación única de ingenieros altamente experimentados,instalaciones de ensayo y desarrollo de última generacióny el impulso constante hacia la innovación. La empresa cuenta con2.850 profesionalesy una red internacional de56 filiales y sucursales en 22 países, lo que garantiza que sus clientes reciban soluciones rápidas y personalizadas.

Job Description

Reporting to the Project Manager, you will be involved in Emissions, Fuel Economy and energy consumption team of Powertrain Department. The activities to be carried out will consist in complete vehicle testing in the field of emissions, fuel and energy consumption, mainly related with Japanese, European and USA... requirements for all kind of vehicle technologies: ICE, PHEV, HEV and EV and special focus on motorcycles.

Responsibilities
• Support a Project Manager with projects related to emission and energy consumption testing.
• Schedule and organization of emissions testing projects.
• Project Management.
• Preparation of the quotation for the customers.
• Check, validation of emission testing and reporting of the projects.
• Presentations (commercials and projects) to the customers.
• Follow up and control of the projects.
• Revision of technical requirements.
• Know how about emission testing protocols (wordwide).
• Organization of technicians and mechanics activities on the emissions laboratory.

Qualifications

Profile
• Previous experience on emissions measurements, testing and project management are valuable.

Education
• Degree in Industrial/mechanical engineering. (MSc valued).
• Other engineering degrees or master acceptable depending on competences and experience.

Languages
• High level of English.
• German valuable.

Additional Information

Applus IDIADA is committed to diversity and inclusion. We don’t put limits on you, so don’t put limits on yourself either. There is a place for everyone

jobs_results.title: SW testing engineer
jobs_results.description:
If you are one of those who, after parking, double checks that you have locked the car...Your place is at GMV!

We are expanding our teams in the space sector to be part of the Galileo project, 'The European GPS'.

We´ll get to the point; we'll tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about us go to GMV website.

WHAT CHALLENGE WILL YOU BE TAKING ON?

In our Galileo SKMF team you will be able to learn about one of the elements that control security in the field of satellite control and be part of the development of functions such as:
• Execution and evolution of software validation tests, continuous validation of the element, integration, acceptance and non-regression tests.
• Test automation through different tools, script development.
• Evolution of the project's testing tools and definition of new test cases.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are looking for computer engineering graduates with knowledge in:
• Testing and validation of SW and... systems based on requirements.
• Operating Systems: Unix
• Script generation (shell script, python)
• Automation: UFT One, selenium, postman.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

🕑 Presential working model.

💻 Flexible start and finish times, and intensive working hours Fridays and in summer.

🚀 Personalized career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Do you come from another country? We can offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive compensation with ongoing reviews, flexible compensation and discount on brands.

💪Wellbeing program: Health, dental and accident insurance; free fruit and coffee, physical, mental and financialhealth training, and much more!

⚠️ In our recruitment processes you will always have telephone and personal contact, face-to-face or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted through any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment, and we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN US

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Clara Sanchez Lobato, in charge of this vacancy.

Clara Sanchez Lobato

jobs_results.title: Network testing engineer Galileo
jobs_results.description:
Do you like network testing and are you looking for a project that motivates you?

If you like to carry out tests, your site is in GMV!

We are expanding our Network Validation team for the Galileo project, 'The European GPS'.

We like to get to the point, so we're going to tell you what's not on the web. If you want to know more about GMV: www.gmv.com/en-es/about-gmv

WHAT CHALLENGE ARE YOU GOING TO FACE?

In our incredible and amazing crew you will support the Galileo validation team, where you will learn all the elements that make up a control center and you will perform tasks such as tests with satellite control center network equipment.

WHAT DO WE NEED IN OUR TEAM?

For this position, we are looking for engineering profiles with an interest in the world of testing. We will also value previous experience and knowledge in:
• Linux operating system
• LAN/WAN networks (switches, firewalls, VPNs)
• Participation in test campaigns: planning, preparation, execution, reports.

We will... value knowledge or interest in:
• Management of requirements and/or tests, such as DOORS, qTest, test link or test rail -
• Incident/ticket management, such as Jira, Bugzilla or Redmine -
• Scripting, such as bash or python.
• Communications protocols in networks, applications to measure performance and network bottlenecks.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

💻 Hybrid working model and 8 weeks per year of teleworking outside your usual geographical area.

🕑 Flexible start and finish times and intensive working hours on Fridays and summer.

🚀 Personalised career plan development, training and language learning support.

🌍 National and international mobility. Coming from another country? We offer you a relocation package.

💰 Competitive remuneration with ongoing reviews, flexible remuneration and brand discounts.

💪Wellbeing programme: medical, dental and accident insurance, free fruit and coffee, training in physical, mental and financial health, and much more!

In our selection processes, you will always have telephone and personal contact, in person or online, with our talent acquisition team. In addition, bank transfers and bank cards will never be requested. If you are contacted by any other process, please write to our team at privacy@gmv.com.

❤️We promote equal opportunities in recruitment and are committed to inclusion and diversity.

WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? JOIN

If you have any questions please do not hesitate to contact Clara Sanchez Lobato, in charge of this vacancy.

Clara Sanchez Lobato

jobs_results.title: 🇪🇸 SOFTWARE TEST & VALIDATION ENGINEER
jobs_results.description:
DOGA has more than 60 years of experience in the development and production of automotive components. With affiliated companies in Italy, USA, Mexico, Brazil, China, India and Morocco we sale our products to more than 70 countries and operate in multiple markets, including industrial vehicles, buses, trains, agriculture and construction machinery, boats, motorcycles and passenger cars.

We are looking for a Software Test & Validation Engineer, reporting directly to Electronic Systems Manager. As a member of DOGA's electronic systems department, he/she will validate the software of new developments for electronic engines and control units to ensure their proper functioning.

Essential Tasks
• Perform specification studies.
• Design tests and documentation.
• Prepare tests and develop resources.
• Execute and report tests.
• Collaborate closely with the electronic product engineering department.

Profile Required
• Electronics Engineering, or similar.
• At least 2 years of experience in... a similar position.
• Knowledge of C or Python languages.
• Experience with Vector tools (CAN, LIN communication protocols).
• Valuable knowledge of Altium for schematics and layouts consulting and interpretation.
• Valuable knowledge of LabVIEW programming and instrumentation, as well as laboratory equipment.
• Valuable experience with implementation of FCT, ICT and EoL verification for the HW.
• Valuable knowledge of the automotive functional safety ISO 26262.
• High level of both oral and written English.
• Proactivity, resolution and decision-making, high creativity.
• Ability to work both autonomously and in multidisciplinary teams.

What We Offer
• 🚀 Join a Thriving Company: Work for a rapidly growing and strategically positioned company.
• ⏰ Flexible Work Schedule: Enjoy flexible working hours and the option for a Friday afternoon off.
• 💻 Hybrid Work Model: Experience a hybrid work environment that combines office and remote work.
• 😀 Customizable Benefits Package: Take advantage of a flexible payment plan that includes options such as kindergarten support, education benefits, transport allowances, gourmet vouchers, or medical insurance.
• 👋 Dynamic Team Environment: Collaborate in active work environment alongside a team of highly qualified and dedicated professionals.
• 🌍 Inclusive Culture: Thrive in an inclusive culture that values diversity, where all individuals, regardless of background, gender, sexual orientation, abilities, or gender identity, feel respected and valued.

If you are interested in joining our DOGA team, do not hesitate to apply. We will be happy to talk to you

jobs_results.title: Expert Embedded Software Test Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Daikin Europe N.V. is the European headquarters of the Japanese company, Daikin Industries Ltd. We design, manufacture, and distribute air conditioning and heating systems for commercial, residential, and industrial applications. Our headquarters are located in Brussels, Gent, and Ostend, but through our sales networks, we also have a presence throughout Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. We are the market leader in the field of air conditioning and also offer Total Comfort Solutions in the fields of cooling, heating, ventilation, and related techniques. As a company, we are constantly expanding with extensive international contacts, providing a pleasant, stimulating working environment, and offering extensive training and coaching. Daikin Europe N.V. values highly motivated employees and is always looking for new talent.

Department:

The EMEA Electrics and Control department was created shortly after the establishment of the European Development Center (EDC). It is one of the... fastest-growing departments aimed at facilitating and ensuring the strong future growth of Daikin. The department is located in Gent, Technology Park, and plays a crucial role in developing embedded software & hardware as well as cloud and app development. This year we want to expend our 2nd office in Madrid.

Role Overview:

As an Expert Embedded Software Test Engineer at Daikin Europe N.V., you will lead our embedded software testing efforts, utilizing your deep technical expertise and industry experience to drive continuous improvement in testing strategies and methodologies. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the delivery of robust, high-quality embedded software solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

Responsibilities:
• Lead the design and implementation of embedded software testing strategies, methodologies, and best practices.
• Develop and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for embedded software systems, ensuring thorough coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
• Collaborate with the development team of the automated test framework to set requirements and direction of the automation platform.
• Report defects to the development teams and where needed assist in the root cause analysis with them.
• Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior members of the embedded software testing team, fostering their growth and development.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and prioritize testing requirements, and ensure alignment with project timelines and objectives.
• Stay abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and best practices in embedded software testing, and proactively identify opportunities for innovation and improvement.

Requirements:
• Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
• Minimum of 10 years of experience in embedded software testing, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience with Automatic testing of embedded software.
• Expertise in developing and executing test plans and test cases for embedded software systems, including experience with both manual and automated testing methodologies.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex software issues and identify effective solutions.
• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
• Passion for learning and professional growth, with a commitment to staying current with industry trends and advancements.
• knowledge of: Jenkins, RobotFramework & git is a plus.
• programming skills in languages commonly used for embedded software development (e.g., C/C++, Python) is a plus.
• In-depth knowledge of embedded systems architectures, communication protocols, and hardware/software interfaces is a plus.
• Experience with embedded software development tools and debugging techniques (e.g., IDEs, JTAG debuggers) is a plus.
• experience with heating systems, heatpumps and controls of such systems is a plus.

Join us at Daikin Europe N.V. and be part of a dynamic team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of embedded software testing and delivering innovative solutions that make a difference

jobs_results.title: Testing & Optimization Engineer - Australia
jobs_results.description:
Enertis Applus+ es una firma global de Consultoría e Ingeniería, líder en el sector de las energías renovables y soluciones de almacenamiento. Tenemos presencia en más de 65 países, y participación en diferentes asociaciones del sector.

Nuestra experiencia y «know-how» garantiza soluciones adaptadas a los desafíos y problemas de nuestros clientes. Perseguimos la excelencia asegurando la calidad y la mejora continua de nuestras actividades y procesos, alcanzando los más altos estándares de calidad.

Somos una empresa ágil y transparente, que asegura la neutralidad y apuesta firmemente por el asesoramiento al cliente.

Nuestro departamento de Testing & Optimization asesora a nuestros clientes realizando inspecciones técnicas para detectar fallos o defectos en los componentes de los proyectos renovables, especialmente durante las fases de construcción y operación.

Contamos con laboratorios fijos y móviles, drones, herramientas basadas en tecnologías de Machine Learning y Data Science y... un equipo de expertos que se trasladan a los proyectos para llevar a cabo pruebas y ensayos in situ que nos permitan indicarles a nuestros clientes el status actual de sus parques y proyectos.

¿Sabías que nuestro laboratorio de ensayos, el PV Mobile Laboratory, fue el primero acreditado como laboratorio privado de la industria en 2012?

¿Y que hemos desarrollado el Enertis’ Quality Assurance Program (EQAP), centrado en la reducción de riesgos / costes, y la optimización de la producción?

Actualmente, estamos buscando una persona que se incorpore como Ingeniero de Testing para gestionar proyectos y llevar a cabo pruebas y ensayos en nuestros proyectos dentro de la península y el resto de Europa, y relocalizarse en Australia en 1 año aproximadamente. Entre otras, las funciones de este puesto serán:
• Ejecutar pruebas en módulos e instalaciones fotovoltaicas en campo y en el laboratorio.
• Asesorar al cliente en la prueba más adecuada para realizar.
• Tratamiento y análisis de resultados.
• Preparación de reportes técnicos.
• Reporte al cliente de los informes y propuestas de optimización.
• Apoyo en la definición y coordinación de aspectos relacionados con la implementación de nuevos laboratorios y pruebas en campo.
• Apoyo en el mantenimiento del sistema de calidad del departamento.

¿Qué necesitamos?
• Grado en ingeniería eléctrica, química o mecánica.
• Disponibilidad de movilidad geográfica nacional e internacional.
• Nivel de inglés Avanzado.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Incorporación a un equipo consolidado.
• Plan de carrera interno.
• Empresa en constante crecimiento

Actualmente, estamos buscando una persona que se incorpore como Ingeniero de Testing para gestionar proyectos y llevar a cabo pruebas y ensayos en nuestros proyectos dentro de la península y el resto de Europa, y relocalizarse en Australia en 1 año aproximadamente. Entre otras, las funciones de este puesto serán:
• Ejecutar pruebas en módulos e instalaciones fotovoltaicas en campo y en el laboratorio.
• Asesorar al cliente en la prueba más adecuada para realizar.
• Tratamiento y análisis de resultados.
• Preparación de reportes técnicos.
• Reporte al cliente de los informes y propuestas de optimización.
• Apoyo en la definición y coordinación de aspectos relacionados con la implementación de nuevos laboratorios y pruebas en campo.
• Apoyo en el mantenimiento del sistema de calidad del departamento.

¿Qué necesitamos?
• Grado en ingeniería eléctrica, química o mecánica.
• Disponibilidad de movilidad geográfica nacional e internacional.
• Nivel de inglés Avanzado.

¿Qué ofrecemos?
• Incorporación a un equipo consolidado.
• Plan de carrera interno.
• Empresa en constante crecimiento
